channel.title: Upshot weekly essentials
channel.description: Five stories a week chosen as most worth acting on, each with what to do.

item.title: Essentials for the week of Nov 1
item.description:
1. SonicWall warns of new SSL-VPN MFA bypass flaw exploited in attacks (BleepingComputer)
    Patch SonicOS now; the SSL-VPN bypass is already being exploited against firewalls.
  2. Shai-Hulud Descendant Surfaces in Malicious Ruby Gem That Steals Credentials and Poisons AI Tools (Socket)
    Audit installs for this gem; revoke stolen GitHub tokens carefully, since revocation triggers wiping.
  3. Chainalysis Breach Exposes All Users' Credentials, Forces Shutdown of Key Services (The Hacker News)
    If you used Chainalysis, rotate passwords and any tokens now; assume they're exposed.
  4. GitHub to Block pull_request_target Workflows by Default Starting December 2 (Socket)
    Audit pull_request_target workflows before December 2 to avoid breaking CI.
  5. Critical Linux kernel TCP vulnerability can allow remote code execution (CVE-2026-98432) (Aikido)
    Patch Linux kernels promptly; CVSS 9.8 remote flaw with code execution potential.
